article.body:
Preliminary benchmark measures power use of locally deployed LLM inference on consumer GPUs

An arXiv study dated 28 September 2026 evaluates locally deployed large language model inference on consumer GPU hardware; it is a measurement study, not a pilot line, demonstration facility or production operation. The measured operation is GPU-based LLM inference, with the paper focused on energy efficiency and power consumption. The supplied record provides no verified throughput, energy-per-inference figure, GPU count or model-specific result. It therefore identifies consumer-GPU power use as the subject of measurement, but does not establish the equipment, energy or deployment constraints that would determine production-scale operation.
